spellbook.finance/limitations: tier is the access the workspace has now, after any trial expiry. status is the stored plan status, and none means the workspace has no plan record.

scope is workspace; observedAt timestamps this read. managedListedUnitCount is a bounded observation of listed copies and usageLimitations name evidence it cannot see. selectedListingKeyCountIsExact applies only to explicit selected-policy membership rows; it does not make unenumerated all-mode or other-channel totals exact. limitKind is soft and nominalUnitAllowance is 10,000. Compatibility fields activeUnitCount and cap mirror observed usage and the nominal allowance. headroom is distance to that allowance, clamped at zero; overCap compares the observation with it. Neither field blocks a write. These are read-time facts, not a guarantee of later inventory or capacity. sellerSource names the access source.

enforcementEnabled reports the legacy count-based allowance gate and is false for the soft allowance. It does not replace sellerToolsUnlocked, which reports the caller's workspace Seller eligibility. A null transitionGraceExpiresAt means no grace deadline is recorded; grace is a compatibility field and does not determine soft-allowance writes.

claimed reports whether the owner selected this workspace for free Seller access. It does not mean the access rollout is enabled or that this caller has Seller entitlement; read sellerToolsUnlocked for that.

sellerToolsUnlocked reports the caller's Seller entitlement, not whether channel automation is enabled. This status does not prove checkout or payment settlement, and it does not report all-in Seller economics.
It returns no payment method, invoice, or Stripe identifier.

tier and status describe the workspace plan only. A person-level Pro plan also grants seller access, so tier free does not mean the seller cannot publish. sellerToolsUnlocked is the answer to whether they can.

description: Read one workspace's Store plan and Seller usage status: tier, stored plan status, trialExpiresAt, sellerToolsUnlocked, and freeSellerCap's scope, observedAt, sellerSource, limitKind, nominalUnitAllowance, managedListedUnitCount, selectedListingKeyCount, count exactness, usageLimitations, and compatibility fields. selectedListingKeyCount counts explicit selected TCGplayer and ManaPool policy memberships; it is not a total of current marketplace keys. Legacy all-mode, eBay, and CardTrader key totals are not enumerated. The 10,000-unit figure is a soft reference. A free owner must explicitly choose one workspace with spellbook_free_seller_workspace_claim before free Seller access begins. Read this status again after the claim.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

workspaceId.description: The workspace to read the plan for. The caller must be a member. Required.

name: spellbook_workspace_plan_status
